_readme: Copy this file to config.json and change what you need; anything left out keeps its default (npcgen/config.py explains every setting). Keys that start with _ are ignored.
_options: What a request that names no engine gets. The defaults are Qwen-Image 2512 and Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (Apache-2.0, about 29 GB of VRAM). For a smaller card use the built-in Mage-Flow: {"image_model": "mage", "edit_model": "mage", "engine_fallback": true}, but read its licence note in NOTICE.md first.
_blender: Blender is found in C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation or on the PATH; name it here if it is elsewhere.
